uncertainty: Twelve alternating paired updates per change and scale; rotating full/core execution order and alternating validated transaction order. Medians and inclusive IQRs are process observations, not independent-site estimates.
memory_scope: Recursive retained-object measurements include each cache's owned fact copy and use identity-deduplicated sys.getsizeof over cache roots; the caller's input, process RSS and browser memory are excluded.
measurement_scope: Complete normalized snapshot difference plus validated transaction and complete issue materialization. HTML parsing, framework builds and event acquisition are excluded.
